semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides critical contamination control and HVAC systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Clean & Science specializes in advanced filtration materials and systems crucial for maintaining cleanroom environments in semiconductor manufacturing. Their product offerings include cleaning, washing, and drying equipment for substrate and fabrication processing, as well as HVAC systems that control temperature and humidity.
capabilities: Cleaning, washing, and drying equipment for substrates
HVAC systems for temperature and humidity control
HEPA filtering systems and cleanroom supplies
